tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Level 0, the desk: the page, the side navigation and input wells. No edge.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Level 1: panels and the app window, with a line outline.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Level 2: cards, the detail pane and row hover.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: The selected nav item, the secondary button, the selected segment, the score 0 chip and overlays (menus, sheets, toasts).

tokens.name: surface-4
tokens.usage: Pressed controls, secondary button hover, avatars and meter tracks.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Deprecated name for surface-0. Kept so existing screens compile.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Deprecated name for surface-1. Kept so existing screens compile.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Deprecated. The old sunken role is split: input wells are surface-0, meter tracks surface-4, the score 0 chip surface-3, and table headers have no fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel outlines. The text colour at 7%, so it holds on every surface step.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons, keycaps and overlays, and the dashed No reading outline.

tokens.name: line-hover
tokens.usage: Border of an input under the pointer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: names, values and headings. 16:1 on surface-0. Also the fill of the Overdue chip.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: body copy, labels and units. 7.5:1 on surface-0.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: captions, column heads, placeholders and ages. About 4.8:1 on surface-0; do not use it on surface-3 or above for text that must be read.

tokens.name: ink-bright
tokens.usage: The name and readings on an urgent row, and the hover fill of the primary button. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Ice, the one accent: the live trace, the focus ring, the selected nav icon, progress and links. Never a large fill and never a status.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and the colour of live numerals.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Live tag and the 3px focus halo of an input.

tokens.name: signal-line
tokens.usage: Outline of something that is live: the viewfinder while a sitting runs.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal or signal-strong fill.

tokens.name: stable
tokens.usage: Severity, stable: an observed patient with score 0. A cool grey, because unflagged is not the same as well.

tokens.name: stable-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the stable chip.

tokens.name: watch
tokens.usage: Severity, watch: score 1 or 2, or a shift from the check-in baseline. Text, dot and the 2px row edge.

tokens.name: watch-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the watch chip and the score 1 chip.

tokens.name: watch-strong
tokens.usage: Background of the score 2 chip.

tokens.name: urgent
tokens.usage: Severity, urgent: score 3 or a rising score. The only saturated fill in the product. Also the text and border of a destructive action and of a field error.

tokens.name: urgent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an urgent row, the handoff note and the hover of a destructive button.

tokens.name: urgent-soft-hover
tokens.usage: An urgent row under the pointer.

tokens.name: urgent-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the handoff note and the divider under a selected urgent row.

tokens.name: urgent-line-strong
tokens.usage: Border of the destructive button.

tokens.name: on-urgent
tokens.usage: Text and dot on an urgent fill: the urgent chip and the score 3 chip.

tokens.name: flag
tokens.usage: Deprecated name for watch. A trend flag is now styled by its severity: urgent for a rising score, watch for a baseline shift.

tokens.name: flag-soft
tokens.usage: Deprecated name for watch-soft.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Deprecated name for urgent.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Deprecated name for urgent-soft.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Deprecated name for on-urgent.

tokens.name: overdue
tokens.usage: Fill of the Overdue chip: the inverse of the page, so it outranks a tinted chip by lightness alone.

tokens.name: on-overdue
tokens.usage: Text on the overdue fill.

tokens.name: score-0
tokens.usage: Partial NEWS2 score 0 chip. Digit in on-score-0.

tokens.name: on-score-0
tokens.usage: Digit on the score 0 chip.

tokens.name: score-1
tokens.usage: Partial NEWS2 score 1 chip. Digit in on-score-1.

tokens.name: on-score-1
tokens.usage: Digit on the score 1 chip.

tokens.name: score-2
tokens.usage: Partial NEWS2 score 2 chip. Digit in on-score-2.

tokens.name: on-score-2
tokens.usage: Digit on the score 2 chip.

tokens.name: score-3
tokens.usage: Partial NEWS2 score 3 chip, the only solid one. Digit in on-score-3.

tokens.name: on-score-3
tokens.usage: Digit on the score 3 chip.

tokens.name: series-estimate
tokens.usage: The camera estimate on a chart and the live trace: solid, 1.5px.

tokens.name: series-reference
tokens.usage: A comparison line on a chart: dashed. Told apart from the estimate by dash and lightness, not hue.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs, and behind the timer on the viewfinder.

weights.name: medium
weights.usage: Headings, names, button labels and anything that needs to stand out. The heaviest weight on the web.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: The live value on the camera phone, read from across the desk.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: A live reading on the dashboard.

styles.name: readout-md
styles.usage: Patient detail, summaries and flag cards.

styles.name: readout-sm
styles.usage: Vitals in a table row, timers and clock times.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Vital signs without touching the patient
styles.usage: The landing page headline only. Scale it down with the viewport; never below 36px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per screen: the page or mobile screen title. Title 1 in the spec.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and sheet titles, the patient name. Title 2 in the spec.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Section and card headings, the page name in the dashboard header. Heading in the spec.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Start a check-in on the camera phone
styles.usage: Prose on the web, list rows on mobile.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, large button labels.

styles.name: body-touch
styles.sample: Sit still and face the phone
styles.usage: Anything a patient reads on the camera phone, and mobile text that is tapped.

styles.name: dense
styles.usage: The dashboard's working size: tables, navigation and inputs.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Dense at medium weight: button labels, names in a row, card titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field labels, units, column heads, chips and ages. Sentence case, never all caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip, a nudge between a value and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, icon to label in a button.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, gap between cards in a grid, sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, the screen gutter on mobile, the header's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding and the dashboard's page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between major blocks on the landing page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Deprecated name for space-12, kept at its old value so existing screens compile.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chip: severity chips, score chips, keycaps, the timer and the selected segment.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Control: buttons, inputs, nav items and the segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panel: panels, cards, the viewfinder and the handoff note.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Window: sheets, dialogs and mobile cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The switch, dots and avatars only. Chips are not pills.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The one shadow: menus, sheets, dialogs and toasts, on surface-3 with a line-strong outline. Nothing inside the app's layout has a shadow.

tokens.name: glow-live
tokens.usage: The head of a live trace and the dot of the Live tag, only while a camera is reading.

tokens.name: glow-urgent
tokens.usage: The dot on an urgent flag. These two are the only glows in the product.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and the segmented control on the web.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the large web button: the landing page and sign-in.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs on mobile, and the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Height of a table row.

tokens.name: nav-row
tokens.usage: Height of a navigation item. Items sit 2px apart.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon box in the dashboard. Stroke 1.5.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: Width of the dashboard side navigation.

tokens.name: detail-width
tokens.usage: Width of the patient detail pane beside the worklist.

tokens.name: phone-width
tokens.usage: Reference width for mobile layouts.

durations.name: duration-tick
durations.usage: A reading changing: the new digits rise 28% of their height into place.

durations.name: duration-enter
durations.usage: Sheets and menus, a new flag arriving.
